title: LLMを検査支援に使うと、要求文書のSmell検出精度がかえって下がる
summary: 人間が書いた要求仕様のInspectionでLLM支援を併用すると、欠陥(Requirements smell)の検出精度が有意に低下する。分類精度と作業時間には有意差がないため、時間短縮と引き換えでもない純粋な検出漏れである。LLMが指摘しなかった箇所を「問題なし」と読む false assurance が働き、検査者の探索が早期に打ち切られる。さらに最初からLLM支援ありで学習した被験者は学習効果自体が減衰しており、初学者の検査技能獲得を遅らせる。

evidence.title: Human-AI Collaboration in Requirements Engineering: Evidence of the Negative Effect of LLMs on Requirements Inspection
evidence.summary: Controlled crossover experiment with 34 participants inspecting textual specifications with and without LLM assistance. LLM support significantly reduced smell-detection accuracy with no significant effect on classification or task duration; learning effects were present across periods but reduced when LLM support was used from the beginning.

notes: Checked against J05 (over-trusting AI and missing plausible errors), J04 (review degenerating into formal approval), J08 (skill atrophy), J09 (juniors losing learning opportunities). J04/J05 concern humans reviewing AI-produced output; here the artifact under inspection is human-authored and the AI is the review aid, so the failure is AI silence read as clearance - the opposite direction, with a different response (keep an unaided inspection pass, and do not introduce LLM aids to novices before baseline skill is established). Overlaps J08/J09 on the learning-effect finding; controller may prefer to split that half into an update on J09.
